topography.project_purpose: Interface. Structurally: 75 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (hedgerpartybv3, hedgerpartybv2, hedgerpartybv1). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
